CLASS GYMNAST STANCE

Your entire form becomes a reactive defence, slipping and guiding enemies away from your centre.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 10 ranks

Action 1 AP

While in this stance:

- When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may spend your Reaction to cause them to become Flat-Footed until the end of their next turn.

- If they fumble the attack against you, you may also attempt a free Trip check against them.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, two with Stance Mastery). While in it, when a creature misses you with a melee attack you are asked whether to spend your reaction: it is then flat-footed until the end of its next turn. If the attack was a fumble you may also make a Trip against it, free (no AP, no further reaction), through the system's own Trip.
